notes: Additive only. Do not conflate actorId, botUsername, and env. Symbol is display/compat; market identity is exchange+marketType+instrumentId.

actorId.meaning: Web user id (JWT subject / web_users._id string)

botUsername.meaning: UserApi / RUN account username (exchange credential owner)

env.meaning: Config / monitor env name under an account
env.notes: Sibling monitors = same API credentials + symbol + side, different env

exchange.meaning: Venue id from UserApi / adapter factory

marketType.meaning: Contract class for linear USDT-M first

instrumentId.meaning: Canonical instrument; often equals symbol; OKX may keep SWAP id

tradeInstanceId.meaning: One open→close lifecycle; never reuse account|symbol|side alone
tradeInstanceId.migration: additive; journal legacy without it stays readable as legacy_unresolved

signalEventId.renamePolicy: prefer signalEventId in new events; keep eventId as alias on ingest

clientOrderId.meaning: Client order id bound to reservation when placed

messId.meaning: MQTT payload dedupe prefix only — NOT a trade id

livePaper.rule: Separate books in every cache, query, aggregate, export
